verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Claude Code consuming credentials, such as an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the Claude Console or a Console login. It does not show Claude Code itself issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The nearby items do not count: sandbox file and network boundaries, Agent SDK permissions, and Enterprise role-based permissions are adjacent controls, developer building blocks or host-platform features, not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
